aiSummary: In October 2026, Safari iPad led browser versions (tablet) in United States at 33.88% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Chrome for Android ranked second at 26.72%, followed by Chrome iPad at 17.88%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browser versions (tablet) in United States?

faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.
